يستكثرون (form X)
# يَسْتَكْثِرُونَ (yastakṯirūna) /jas.tak.θi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# يُسْتَكْثَرُونَ (yustakṯarūna) /jus.tak.θa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
